summary: Closed environment-limited audit trail for the live hibernation card. The app ships the powercfg-backed action and correctly reports firmware-limited VMs as not applicable, but this command card is rejected for research-provider promotion until a hibernation-capable validation lane exists.

setting.name: Disable Hibernation
setting.casual_explanation: This turns off Windows hibernation so the system stops using hiberfil.sys and frees that disk space.
setting.why_people_change_it: People disable hibernation when they want to reclaim disk space or never use hibernate on that machine.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: Disabling hibernation frees space and removes the hibernate option on systems that support S4 hibernation. The current KVM validation lane does not support hibernation, so the app must report not applicable there instead of attempting a fake mutation.
setting.professional_notes: The current app models this card as a command tweak that detects with powercfg /availablesleepstates, applies powercfg /hibernate off, and restores the previous state with powercfg /hibernate on when rollback is appropriate. Repo power docs and tweak provenance both map the tweak id to that same action, and the sibling power.control.hibernate-enabled record carries cross-layer evidence for the underlying HibernateEnabled control. This app card remains rejected for research-provider promotion until a hibernation-capable VM or bare-metal validation lane can prove mutation behavior directly.

decision.why: The app mapping is documented, the sibling HibernateEnabled raw control has cross-layer evidence, and 2026-05-07 plus 2026-05-08 app QA prove correct firmware-limited not-applicable handling on the available VM. Direct apply/rollback mutation proof still requires a hibernation-capable VM or bare-metal lane, so this app card is closed as rejected for research-provider promotion rather than left as an active blocker.
decision.promotion_disposition_reason: Closed as rejected for research-provider promotion because the current VM firmware does not support hibernation; the app correctly reports NotApplicable, while direct mutation proof must wait for a hibernation-capable validation lane.
